about: Tim's research questions, kept in his own words. Claude never drafts or rewords a question. When Tim asks for a cleanup, only capitalization, spelling and grammar change, and the captured wording stays in original. Tier is primary, sub or inquiry. Answered by is source, build or playtest. Tier, answered_by and status are Tim's to set.

questions.text: The primary question is how we make a player feel OUTLAW, and secondarily PRIDE in the product. They can be oppositional and complementary, as the player treads a line between fame and infamy in the county.
questions.original: the primary question is how do we make a player feel SCOUNDREL and secondarily PRIDE in the product. That can be oppositional and complimentary.
questions.edited: 2026-10-28, capitalization and grammar at Tim's request; 2026-10-28, pillar word SCOUNDREL changed to OUTLAW by Tim's decision; 2026-10-28, Tim added the fame and infamy clause, grammar fixed at his OK
